name: Effects Gallery
description: Apply one of 17 visual effects presets — levitation, glass shatter, liquid chrome melt, slow-motion embers, frost freeze, balloon inflate, or floral explosion — to any product or subject photo. Estimated cost is about $0.30 to $0.85 per clip on fal at provider list price, or $0 locally with Wan 2.2.

data.comment:
# Effects Gallery

**Effects Gallery** turns a single product or subject photo into a stylized visual-effects shot.

1. Pick a preset from **Effect Preset** (levitation, liquid chrome, glass shatter, frost crystals, embers, and more) and set **Effect Intensity**.
2. **Template** formats the physical simulation prompt and feeds **ImageToVideo** to render the VFX clip.
